title: Opera
tagline: Drama told through voices, orchestra, and a fully staged musical world.
summary: Opera combines music, drama, and theatrical staging, typically using sung roles supported by an orchestra. Since its beginnings in Europe around the turn of the 17th century, it has developed into a wide range of forms and national traditions. Operatic repertoire continues to be performed in historic houses and reimagined in contemporary productions.

pillars.name: Claudio Monteverdi
pillars.why: Monteverdi's early operas helped establish the genre's musical and dramatic possibilities.

pillars.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
pillars.why: Mozart composed operas that remain central to the repertoire for their musical craft and vivid characters.

pillars.name: Giuseppe Verdi
pillars.why: Verdi shaped Italian opera through memorable melodies and dramatically focused writing.
